key_findings: EBS v0.4 did not expose genuine programme omissions from LLM v0.1; the v0.1 official-site extraction already has broader programme coverage than the crawler candidate set.
LLM v0.2 keeps all eight v0.1 programme records and treats v0.4 differences mainly as naming, grouping, or schema-granularity issues.
Confirmed fee and timing facts from official pages were refreshed where useful, but v0.2 does not let crawler naming noise overwrite stronger v0.1 admissions logic.
Crawler language pollution such as English/German/Deutsch is classified as navigation contamination and not imported where official programme pages support English-only instruction.
known_gaps: The public application portal was not entered; only public official EBS pages were used.
Exact component scores and test validity periods for EBS English tests were not found in the reviewed public page text.
The repo files are UTF-8, but Windows console rendering may show EBS Universit?t as mojibake under legacy code pages.
